name: No more turns stuck on 'working…'
description: Two hangs showed the same 'working…' with an empty prompt. (1) A model's ask_user arguments that were not valid JSON became null, so rusti asked an empty question that sat unseen while the hint said 'working…'. Now a call whose non-empty arguments do not parse is refused back to the model with the parse error and a resend instruction (one check in run_agent beside the empty-name refusal), ask_user with no non-empty question returns an error result instead of asking, and while a free-text question is pending the hint reads 'answer above · enter sends · esc cancels'. (2) A provider that went quiet mid-reply with the socket open held the turn forever, and Esc could not reach it because cancel was only read between chunks. Now every wait on the server in chat_stream (send, error body, each chunk) wakes every 100 ms to honour Esc and fails after a phase-specific silence: 10 min before the first data line (send, error body, first event) with 'no response for 10 min', so slow prefill or unstreamed reasoning still works, and 120 s between chunks after that with 'stream stalled: no data for 120s', and the reply ends at data: [DONE] instead of waiting for the server to close.
evidence: Reproduced first, all failing on 01644e7: tests/rpc.rs ask_user_without_a_usable_question_is_refused_not_asked (arguments '', 'null', raw newline in a string), abort_ends_a_stalled_stream (held socket, abort -> task_end within 5 s), a_done_line_ends_the_reply_without_waiting_for_close (held socket after [DONE]); tui::render::tests::a_pending_question_asks_for_an_answer_not_working. Added ai_core::llm::tests::a_silent_stream_fails_as_stalled (between-chunks limit shortened to 300 ms) and silence_before_the_first_data_line_gets_the_longer_limit (limits injected). All pass after the change: cargo test 114 unit + 6 rpc + 1 trust. cargo clippy --all-targets adds no warnings (the ones it prints predate this change). Root cause from the captain's 9router request log and session files (rusti-stuck-s1 report); the TUI was driven under ConPTY against a fake server for both screenshots before the fix.
decisions: The stall limit and the cancel tick live in one Client::wait used by every await on the server, so agent turns, compaction, delegate and RPC all get them; a stalled send is not retried, since three more 10 min waits would be the hang again.
Unparseable arguments are refused once per tool call in run_agent, not per tool; empty arguments still mean 'no arguments' and 'null' parses, so ask_user keeps its own empty-question check.
The idle limits are two constants (FIRST_WAIT 10 min, STALL 120 s) with private Client fields only so a test can shorten them; no config knob.
Skipped: object-valued arguments, a streaming tool-call args display, and the manual-mode outside-root double prompt (recorded in harness/open-work.md).
